style: STYLE: traditional Chinese shadow puppet (piying) figure, match the style reference image: dyed translucent leather in deep cinnabar red, jade green, black lacquer and antique gold, intricate hollowed-out lace carving (peony, cloud and fret patterns cut clean through the leather), crisp flat silhouettes, fine dark carved outlines, warm backlit glow, small round antique-bronze rivets at every joint. Flat 2D, no perspective, no cast shadows, no lighting gradients beyond the leather glow.

parts.prompt:
Use case: production sprite atlas for a 2D cutout puppet rig in a side-scrolling game. Match the boy on the LEFT of reference 1 and the face and hat in reference 2. A nimble slim teenage boy, clean youthful amber profile with fine brow and almond eye, black tousled hair beneath broad open-lattice woven bamboo douli with vermilion ties; vermilion scarf wound at neck with long trailing tails, fitted peacock jade short tunic with gold pierced cloud motifs, red sash, dark brown gathered trousers, wrapped calves and dark cloth boots. Strict RIGHT-facing side profile, orthographic, every piece at the same scale.
Technical layout is critical: landscape 3:2 atlas, exactly three rows of four columns, one separate piece centred in each cell, generous empty gutters, pieces never touch each other or the cell edges, no labels, no text, no assembled figure, no extra objects. Background: fully transparent if possible, otherwise perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF; the lace holes must show that background through them. Do not paint any white or near-white colour on the puppet itself; the lightest colour is warm amber.
Every limb piece hangs straight down with its upper joint end at the TOP as a rounded disc with one bronze rivet at the disc centre, and its lower end also rounded where the next piece overlaps.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) head and neck in side profile, shadow-puppet face (long almond eye, straight nose line, painted brows), short black hair under the woven openwork bamboo hat, neck ends in a rounded disc with rivet at the bottom; (2) a separate long vermilion scarf streamer, root at the upper RIGHT, flowing down and back to the LEFT, carved lace; (3) armless torso from collar to and including the wide sash belt, carved lace cloud-pattern robe chest, round rivet disc at the shoulder position, no arms, no sleeves hanging; (4) hip panel directly under the belt, top edge straight, rounded hip joint.
ROW 2 left to right: (1) upper arm hanging straight down: slim jade carved sleeve from rounded shoulder disc (rivet at top) to elbow; (2) forearm hanging straight down: sleeve cuff and carved bracer, ends at the wrist, no hand; (3) tightly clenched right fist seen from the side, wrist at the TOP, fingers curled around an invisible round handle that runs from upper-left to lower-right, a clear round hole through the fist where the handle goes, no weapon; (4) open left hand, wrist at the top, fingers relaxed and slightly curved, separate fingers.
ROW 3 left to right: (1) thigh with wide trouser leg hanging straight down from rounded hip disc (rivet) to knee; (2) shin with wrapped leggings and a carved boot as one piece, top at the knee with rivet disc, toes pointing RIGHT, flat sole; (3) a single curved dao in exact side profile lying horizontally: handle and round pommel on the LEFT, carved bronze lace guard, wide curved blade with carved fret pattern near the spine, tip on the RIGHT, cutting edge on the BOTTOM; (4) a short narrow jade tunic front hem panel hanging straight down from a short straight top edge, carved peony lace, tassel at the bottom.
